title: ASP — Anticipating Shadow Points
description: A Claude Code plugin that runs a pre-mortem-first planning protocol for non-trivial engineering tasks, plus a replication layer: every measured number in the two companion papers is re-derived from committed data by run_all.py, asserted by pytest and sealed under one SHA-256 chain hash.
